trainer.name: Blake
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Blake: Every step through this snow is training. A battle is the best step of all!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Blake: I'd blame the snow, but it was you. It was all you.

trainer.name: Laura
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Laura: My Tropius doesn't mind the cold at all. Even the fruit round its neck never freezes!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Laura: Cool as the snow itself. You kept your head the whole way through.

trainer.name: Philip
trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Philip: I train by smashing the ice on this road! Let's see if you crack as easily!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Philip: I was the one who cracked. Back to the ice for me.

trainer.name: Bradley
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Bradley: Look out below! ...Oh, a battle? Sure, I can stop. Eventually!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Bradley: Wiped out! Right into the deepest drift on the slope.

trainer.name: Garrett
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Garrett: You came all the way through the mountain? Then you're worth a battle.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Garrett: You've earned the road ahead. I'll go and thaw out somewhere.

trainer.name: Maria
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Maria: I'm on my way to Snowpoint to take on its Gym. You'll be my warm-up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Maria: If that was the warm-up, I'd better keep training before I reach the Gym.

trainer.name: Kaitlyn
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Kaitlyn: Fresh snow, clear skies and a trainer to battle. What a perfect day!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Kaitlyn: Face first into the snow. Good thing it's soft!

trainer.name: Edward
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Edward: Nobody's faster on these slopes than me, except my Sneasel!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Edward: Too fast for my own good. I went sliding right past the win.

trainer.name: Andrea
trainer.dialogueBefore: Skier Andrea: My Snover and I play out in the snow all day. Want to join in?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Skier Andrea: That wasn't the snowball fight I had in mind.

signs.signboard_snowbound_lodge:
Snowbound Lodge
Come in out of the snow and rest by the fire.
